name: Blanket Drop

scoring.report_note: Report room-level deltas only; individual answers stay private — the free point is the joke, not a grade.

description: One-minute pre/post measure for the Blanket Drop name game. Scores per person: how much of the room's names you actually own — retrieval under pressure is the mechanism.

instructions.pre: Before the teams split. Each person answers alone, about their normal week — the usual, not the game.
instructions.post: Immediately after the light debrief. Same items, now answered about this game.

items.pre_text: I can put names to most faces I work with.
items.post_text: A name I learned today came back to me under pressure.

items.pre_text: When a name escapes me, I avoid using one at all.
items.post_text: Today nobody dodged: every near-miss got a second try.

items.pre_text: Mild time pressure helps me recall things.
items.post_text: When the blanket dropped, my recall got sharper, not frozen.

items.pre_text: I greet colleagues with their name out loud.
items.post_text: Before the break, I used a new name out loud, to the person.

report.title: Blanket Drop — name recall delta
sections: One suggested name to use out loud per participant, from the largest positive delta
